Lenovo Legion R24E (R25i-30) Gaming Monitor

​The Lenovo Legion R24E is a high-performance gaming monitor tailored for smooth gameplay and vibrant visuals. It features a fast IPS panel that balances speed with professional-grade color accuracy.

​Display Specifications

  • ​Panel Size: 23.8-inch (Specifications may vary by region to 24.5-inch)
  • ​Panel Type: IPS (In-Plane Switching)
  • ​Resolution: 1920 x 1080 (Full HD)
  • ​Refresh Rate: 180Hz
  • ​Response Time: 0.5ms (MPRT) / 1ms (GtG)
  • ​Brightness: 400 nits (Peak)
  • ​Color Gamut: 99% sRGB / 90% DCI-P3
  • ​Contrast Ratio: 1000:1
  • ​HDR: DisplayHDR™ 400 certified

​Gaming & Visual Features

  • ​Sync Technology: AMD FreeSync Premium / G-Sync Compatible.
  • ​Natural Low Blue Light: Reduces eye strain without shifting colors to yellow.
  • ​ClearMR 7000: High motion clarity rating for competitive gaming.
  • ​Game Assist: Tools like aim point, timer, and frame counter via Lenovo Artery software.

​Connectivity & Audio

  • ​DisplayPort: 1 x DisplayPort 1.4
  • ​HDMI: 2 x HDMI 2.1
  • ​Audio: 1 x 3.5mm Audio Out
  • ​Speakers: Dual 3W built-in speakers

​Design & Ergonomics

  • ​Stand Adjustability: * Height (Up to 135mm)
    • ​Tilt (-5° / 22°)
    • ​Swivel (-30° / 30°)
    • ​Pivot (Clockwise/Anti-clockwise 90°)
  • ​VESA Mount: 100 x 100 mm
  • ​Bezel: 3-side NearEdgeless design.

​Key Highlights

  • ​HDR 400 Support: Offers better peak brightness and contrast for a more immersive media and gaming experience.
  • ​Full Ergonomic Stand: Unlike many budget monitors, this stand allows for complete movement, including vertical mode.
  • ​Vibrant Colors: The high sRGB coverage makes it suitable for both gaming and basic creative work.
  • ​Modern Ports: HDMI 2.1 ports ensure compatibility with the latest gaming hardware and stable high refresh rates.
